caption:
Sunday night, and Momo has been ironing at a low board for an hour. Now her back aches when she straightens up.

A low board keeps you bent forward in one position for a long time. Raising it and changing position often can ease the load on your back.

Hybi's tip: set the board at about hip height, rest one foot on a low step, and stand tall and walk every 15 minutes.

Pain spreading down a leg, tingling or weakness is worth an assessment first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD chiropractors can help. Book online via the link in bio
